claim: Third per-task validation of the agentic LLM router: on denoising-dirty-documents, the router decided opus-everywhere — MATCHING the E025 X205 baseline (opus-all gold $10.59) — and reproduced GOLD at score 0.0176 for total $9.20. That's $1.4 below the X205 baseline (-13%), confirming the router's evidence-reading is competent AND that denoising-opus has run-to-run cost variance. n=3 for denoising opus-all (X205 $10.59 gold, E-PN1 $10.67 gold, E-PN4-denoising $9.20 gold — mean $10.15, range $1.47).

support.interpretation: On denoising, the family memory (image-denoising-restoration) likely lists the X205 opus-all gold $10.59 outcome (E025). The agentic router read this and reused the pattern. Unlike nomad2018 where the router DIVERGED from family default toward cheaper (E029 mixed), here it stayed at opus-all because the evidence shows opus-all is the cost-efficient gold-tier config.

agentic_router_track_record.outcome: pipeline failed at designer timeout — routing decision uncontestable but unverified

scope: Single denoising run. Combined with E029 (nomad2018 win) and E030 (leaf correct decision), this is the third data point showing the agentic LLM router is competent at reading evidence and reusing successful patterns.
limitations: n=1 for E-PN4-denoising; n=3 for denoising-opus-all overall.
Did not extract the router's reasoning text (router_cache content) to confirm the agent literally cited E025 — but the pattern match is exact.
Has NOT yet tested per_node_routing=true to see whether per-node divergence on denoising helps or hurts.

implications.agentic_router_validation_summary: The agentic LLM router has now been validated on 3 distinct task families: tabular-regression (nomad2018 cost win), image-classification (leaf — correct match, infra failure separate), image-denoising (denoising — correct match, gold at -13% cost). The agent uses evidence to inform its decisions and gets it right.
implications.next_experiment_design: E-PN5-denoising: same task, NOW with per_node_routing=true. Tests whether per-node divergence helps (router downgrades shallow nodes to sonnet/haiku for exploration, keeps opus on revision nodes near threshold) or hurts (cross-the-board downgrade like E-PN4-nomad). Denoising is the most stable test ground (60min budget, no yaml-template issue, n=3 baseline).

next_actions: Launch E-PN5-denoising: router_strategy=llm + per_node_routing=true on denoising.
If E-PN5-denoising succeeds, the per-node hook + LLM router combo is validated. If it fails or regresses, we have a data point on per-node prompt-design refinement.
